title: Grind coffee beans and brew coffee
summary: Person is following tablet instructions to make coffee: getting beans, weighing with a kitchen scale, preparing an electric blade grinder, then grinding and brewing.

nodes.name: Review the recipe on tablet
nodes.instruction_novice: Read through the coffee instructions on your tablet so you know the amounts and steps.
nodes.end_state: Tablet shows the recipe and the person's hand is away from the screen.

checks.question: Is this step done: Review the recipe on tablet?

nodes.name: Gather beans, grinder, and scale
nodes.instruction_novice: Bring the bag of coffee beans, the grinder, and the kitchen scale to a clear counter space.
nodes.end_state: Beans, grinder, and scale sit together on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather beans, grinder, and scale?

nodes.name: Unbox and set up scale
nodes.instruction_novice: Take the scale out of its box, set it on a flat surface, and turn it on.
nodes.end_state: The scale sits on the counter with its display lit.

checks.question: Is this step done: Unbox and set up scale?

nodes.name: Prepare and clean the grinder
nodes.instruction_novice: Unwind the cord, open the grinder lid, and wipe or rinse out any old grounds before use.
nodes.end_state: Grinder is open with an empty, clean bowl and cord unwound.

checks.question: Is this step done: Prepare and clean the grinder?

nodes.name: Weigh the coffee beans
nodes.instruction_novice: Put a cup on the scale, press tare to zero it, then pour in the amount of beans the recipe calls for.
nodes.end_state: Scale display shows the target bean weight in the cup.

checks.question: Is this step done: Weigh the coffee beans?

nodes.name: Load beans into grinder
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour the weighed beans into the grinder bowl and snap the lid on tightly.
nodes.end_state: Beans are in the grinder with the lid closed.

checks.question: Is this step done: Load beans into grinder?

nodes.name: Plug in and grind
nodes.instruction_novice: Plug in the grinder and press the button in short pulses, shaking gently, until the grounds look even.
nodes.end_state: Grinder bowl holds evenly ground coffee.

checks.question: Is this step done: Plug in and grind?

nodes.name: Heat the water
nodes.instruction_novice: Heat fresh water in a kettle until it's just off the boil.
nodes.end_state: Kettle has finished heating and is steaming.

checks.question: Is this step done: Heat the water?

nodes.name: Add grounds to brewer
nodes.instruction_novice: Unplug the grinder, then tip the grounds into your filter or brewer.
nodes.end_state: Ground coffee sits level in the filter or brewer.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add grounds to brewer?

nodes.name: Brew the coffee
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour hot water over the grounds slowly and let it steep or drip for the recipe's time.
nodes.end_state: Brewed coffee has collected in the mug or carafe.

checks.question: Is this step done: Brew the coffee?

nodes.name: Clean up the grinder
nodes.instruction_novice: Unplug the grinder and brush out leftover grounds, and discard the used grounds.
nodes.end_state: Grinder is empty and unplugged, used grounds discarded.

checks.question: Is this step done: Clean up the grinder?
